p: wall: That his mind might not be troubled.
perfect heart: Meaning, without all hypocrisy.
wept sore: Not so much for his own death, as for fear that idolatry would be restored which he had destroyed, and so God's Name be dishonoured.
prayer: Because of his true repentance and prayer, God turned away his wrath.
house of the LORD: To give thanks for your deliverance.
lump of figs: He declares that though God can heal without other medicines, he will not have these inferior means contemned.
return backward ten degrees: Let the sun go so many degrees back, that the hours may be fewer in the king's dial.
dial of Ahaz: Which was set at the top of the stairs that Ahaz had made.
present unto Hezekiah: Moved by the favour that God showed to Hezekiah, and also because he had declared himself an enemy of Sennacherib who was now destroyed.
dominion: Being moved by ambition and vain glory, and also because he seemed to rejoice in the friendship of him who was God's enemy and an infidel.
spoken: He acknowledges Isaiah to be the true prophet of God and therefore humbles himself to his word.

peace and truth be in my: Seeing that God has shown me this favour to grant me quietness during my life: for he was afraid lest the enemies would have had opportunity to rejoice if the Church had decayed in his time, because he had restored religion.
